facts.fact: MINPOSTEL, with World Bank support under PATNUC, validated a national universal digital service strategy on 8 July 2025 whose deployment axis aims at full coverage of underserved areas by 2030.

The universal service strategy validated on 8 July 2025 calls for relaunching the Fonds special des telecommunications and financing from public resources, sector contributions and private partnerships; no act or amount is reported.
A validation workshop in Yaounde on 8 July 2025 on the national universal digital service strategy brought together administrations, partners, operators, civil society representatives and experts.
facts.system: Validation workshop on the universal digital service strategy
